Heard Mrs. Sujata Chaudhary, learned counsel for applicant and Sri Sunil Srivastava, learned AGA for State.

2. Applicant-Ajay Rathore, has approached this Court by way of filing the present Criminal Misc.
Bail Application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. after rejection of his Bail Application vide order dated 10.12.2021, passed by Sessions Judge, Agra, in Case Crime No.805 of 2021, under Sections 376, 506 IPC, Police Station Tajganj, District Agra.
3. In the present case FIR was lodged by brother of victim.
Victim was working in Godown of Rahul Plastics wherein applicant was also working as Thekedar.
On the date of occurrence when victim was alone at godown, applicant catch hold her and forcefully raped and extended threats also.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for applicant submits that there is a delay of about three days in lodging FIR.

According to victim?s statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. duration of alleged offence was about two hours as well as date of incident was mentioned differently in the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
She further submits that since alleged duration of occurrence was two hours and there is no injury internal or external on the person of victim, therefore, it appears to be a false implication.
Applicant has paid certain amount to victim which she does not want to return.
Victim is a lady of 25 years old and applicant is in jail since 15.11.2021, however, till date even charges are not framed.
5. Learned AGA submits that so far as allegation of rape is concerned, statement of victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. remained consistent.
Effect of minor contradiction with regard to date of occurrence will be considered at the time of trial and word ?Thekedar? was used for applicant as mentioned in FIR also.
6. LAW ON BAIL - A SUMMARY (A) The basic rule may perhaps be tersely put as bail, not jail.

(B) Power to grant bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C., is of wide amplitude but not an unfettered discretion, which calls for exercise in a judicious manner and not as a matter of course or in whimsical manner.

(C) While passing an order on an application for grant of bail, there is no need to record elaborate details to give an impression that the case is one that would result in a conviction or, by contrast, in an acquittal.

However, a Court cannot completely divorce its decision from material aspects of the case such as allegations made against accused; nature and gravity of accusation; having common object or intention; severity of punishment if allegations are proved beyond reasonable doubt and would result in a conviction; reasonable apprehension of witnesses being influenced by accused;
tampering of evidence; character, behaviour, means, position and standing of accused; likelihood of offence being repeated; the frivolity in the case of prosecution; criminal antecedents of accused and a prima facie satisfaction of Court in support of charge against accused.

The Court may also take note of participation or part of an unlawful assembly as well as that circumstantial evidence not being a ground to grant bail, if the evidence/ material collected establishes prima facie a complete chain of events.
Parity may not be an only ground but remains a relevant factor for consideration of application for bail.

(D) Over crowding of jail and gross delay in disposal of cases when undertrials are forced to remain in jail (not due to their fault) may give rise to possible situations that may justify invocation of Article 21 of Constitution, may also be considered along with other factors.

sentences.text: In the present case victim has made consistent averment with regard to allegation of rape on applicant in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. Delay of three days in lodging FIR will not have an adverse effect considering that it is a case of rape.
So far as difference of date is concerned, it has been explained in Majid Byan.
8. Only submission which requires consideration is prolong incarceration of applicant and that till date even charges are not framed.
9. However, considering that applicant has prior acquaintance with victim and in case of grant of bail, there is likelihood that he will try to influence her, prayer for bail is rejected.

10. The application is accordingly disposed of with direction to Trial Court to frame charges and record statement of victim, if not already recorded, within a period of twelve weeks from today, if there is no other legal impediment.
Thereafter applicant is at liberty to file fresh application for bail before Trial Court.
